objective: equal-event arithmetic mean of pooled fixation and saccade training MCC
availability: Maximise candidate-pair joint available eligible training row count
tie_support: Intersection of training trials jointly available for all maximum-availability candidate pairs; evaluate both tasks on this same set
undefined: Candidate inadmissible if either training MCC undefined; no lower-availability fallback
tie_break: J within 1e-12, then Raw/Mean3/Median3/SG5_23, ascending fixation threshold, ascending saccade threshold
evaluation: own_policy_paired_joint: successes for both event calls at both rates per participant; condition_specific_joint and shared_policy_paired_joint additionally reported
CNN: All five fixed held-out branches on original frozen support; no branch selection
